result.question: Quais são as 5 combinações mais frequentes de diagnóstico e especialidade entre homens com mais de 60 anos?
result.gold_sql: SELECT c.CD_DESCRICAO AS diagnostico, e.DESCRICAO AS especialidade, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" WHERE i."SEXO" = 1 AND i."IDADE" > 60 GROUP BY c.CD_DESCRICAO, e.DESCRICAO ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."SEXO" = 1 AND i."IDADE" > 60 GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 5;
